# MCP Apps Phase 1 fixtures

Provider-free, deterministic MCP AppServer fixtures for `task_302`. The canonical
fixture uses one logical Server identity across its stdio and loopback HTTP test
transports; no production composition root imports this directory.

| File | Function |
|---|---|
| `phase1_readonly_appserver.mjs` | Canonical read-only AppServer, descriptor, HTML resource, result, counters, and lifecycle helpers. |
| `phase1_readonly_appserver.test.mjs` | Standard MCP Client protocol, result-equivalence, and teardown contract. |
